definitions.rawFinite: Stored finiteTIP8 circle measurements, including model-invisible/out-of-bounds points, separately counted as diagnostics.
definitions.diagnosticQualified: TAPIR: original visibleProbability>0.5 AND old-center inbounds. CachedNN8: original sole21/finiteXYZ/inbounds only; learnedvisibility UNKNOWN. Neither is application authority.
definitions.contrary: Five contrary-open-palm labels overlap visibility categories; not extra samples and not a false-positive rate.
definitions.uncertainty: Previously exposed AI development circle estimates10-15nativepixels; inclusive containment and inherited strict disjoint intervals, touching intervals overlap. No exact physicalGT.
definitions.intervalCounts: All48 change categories preserved; missing does not earn improvement. Nonpositive and preseed rows remain separate.
definitions.costs: Separate full-sequence checker aggregate; no latency/performance inference made here.
